topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
consensus_response: Satellite orbital configurations, particularly LEO, reduce propagation delays, enhancing ML-based QoS for latency-sensitive traffic. Advanced beamforming and adaptive modulation mitigate interference and atmospheric effects, while ML algorithms optimize path selection, resource allocation, and network slicing to maintain high QoS.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms often neglect fixed latencies in satellite links, impacting performance in converged networks.
